subject.title: [Bug]: Control UI header logo/icon not displaying after 2026.3.24 update

question: Should root-mounted Control UI treat unconfigured deep prefixes such as `/connections/chat` as unsupported routes to redirect, or preserve them as compatibility paths with working public assets and bootstrap config?
rationale: Current main covers root and configured-base public assets, but the remaining source-level failure depends on whether old or arbitrary deep URLs without `gateway.controlUi.basePath` are a supported user path.

options.title: Normalize unsupported prefixes to root routes
options.body: Treat unknown unconfigured prefixes as root-mounted Control UI routes, avoid inferred phantom base paths for config/public assets, and close or replace the conflicting fork PR with a narrow current-main patch.

options.title: Preserve legacy `/connections` compatibility
options.body: Add an explicit compatibility route or redirect for the old Channels path and prove icons, config fetch, and hard refresh behavior under that path.

options.title: Narrow this issue to the shipped root-logo fix
options.body: Declare arbitrary unconfigured deep prefixes unsupported, close this issue as resolved for the root logo, and ask for a separate issue only if a supported route still breaks.

recommendation.title: Normalize unsupported prefixes to root routes
recommendation.body: Treat unknown unconfigured prefixes as root-mounted Control UI routes, avoid inferred phantom base paths for config/public assets, and close or replace the conflicting fork PR with a narrow current-main patch.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent current-main ownership of the route inference and public-asset helper makes this the best available decision owner.
